I am proud to introduce the GENESIS Act to codify President Trump's Genesis Mission into law. This is a pivotal step toward unleashing American ingenuity through artificial intelligence. The GENESIS Act empowers our National Laboratories to integrate artificial intelligence, scientific data, and top researchers into a unified system for breakthrough research.
statements.venue: House press release on GENESIS Act

statements.text:
Today I introduced the Growth, Energy, and National Excellence through Science, Innovation, and Security Act (GENESIS Act) to codify President Trump’s newly signed Executive Order launching the Genesis Mission.

This legislation will empower the federal government to harness artificial intelligence to accelerate scientific discovery, strengthen national security, and keep America ahead in the global AI race.

Congratulations to our Congressional App Challenge winner from Hillcrest High School!

The winning app this year is called FocusMate. FocusMate is an AI powered study buddy that helps students learn efficiently using real time feedback and personalized messages.

The Congressional App Challenge is the official student STEM competition hosted by the US House of Representatives. It’s an annual nationwide competition hosted by Members of Congress designed to inspire middle and high school students to explore STEM fields.

We cannot risk ceding the future of AI to China.

In @housescience I discussed how my GENESIS Act advances the @WhiteHouse’s AI Action Plan and how the federal government should empower state-level experimentation.

Utah’s regulatory sandbox has already proven this model works, and I’m committed to building on that success so we win the AI race.

If I can represent that to the administration, they might just lift the template that already is working and put it into whatever this federal policy ends up being, and lo and behold, Utah is driving the process in a functional way.
statements.venue: Deseret News interview on federal AI framework and Utah's AI policy approach

statements.text:
Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but innovation should never outrun the Constitution.

Technology can help law enforcement fight crime and keep our communities safe, but it should never become a tool for mass surveillance of law-abiding Americans.

Public safety and constitutional liberty are not competing values. We can, and must, protect both.

I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read my latest op-ed.

https://t.co/zDZRHkntYL

As Utah leads the way in protecting our children from the harms of social media and AI, I am working to ensure the federal government is an active partner in those efforts. That is why I am co-leading the Protecting Kids from Human-Like Chatbots Act. 

Human-like AI chatbots pose significant emotional, psychological and safety risks by mimicking real human relationships. AI needs to be a tool, not a friend. This bill sets clear boundaries for how chatbots interact with our children and puts parents fully in charge of these features.

It was a pleasure to speak at the @47G_Utah Summit alongside former Representative Chris Stewart about global AI competition and the role of government in this rapidly evolving field.

Thank you to @47G_Utah for bringing together leaders and keeping Utah at the forefront of these important conversations.
